record.source_text: (1) The following income shall constitute income from capital, to the extent that it does not fall within the income categories referred to in Section 2(1) to (4): 1. a) profit shares (dividends), interest and other distributions from shares or interests in limited liability companies; b) similar distributions and patronage refunds from interests in commercial and industrial cooperatives, excluding those under Section 13 of the Corporate Income Tax Act 1988; c) similar distributions from profit participation rights and from participation capital within the meaning of the Banking Act or the Insurance Supervision Act. 2.
